about.title: We show China's tech scene from the inside
about.intro: SinoTech Voyage was founded by engineers and China specialists tired of tourist routes with no substance. We build trips for people who want to understand how the technology industry actually works.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To open up China's tech scene to entrepreneurs, engineers, investors, and anyone curious about the future of manufacturing and innovation — through firsthand experience, not slide decks.

items.title: Substance over spectacle
items.description: Every stop is chosen for what you'll see and learn, not for the photo op.

items.title: Direct relationships
items.description: We work directly with companies and tech parks — no middlemen, no scripted tours.

items.title: Tailored to you
items.description: Routes adapt to your group's interests: manufacturing, AI, robotics, or clean energy.

team.title: The team
team.text: Our team includes engineers, China specialists, and business travel organizers with experience across the tech clusters of Shenzhen, Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Beijing.

tours.title: Tours
tours.subtitle: Every route is built around a specific technology theme and includes on-site factory visits

items.title: EVs & Batteries of Shenzhen
items.description: Electric vehicle production lines, battery R&D, and the headquarters of leading tech companies.

items.title: Robotics & AI of Hangzhou
items.description: Humanoid robotics labs, startup accelerators, and the region's leading AI companies.

items.title: Smart Manufacturing of Shanghai
items.description: Automated factories, industrial robotics, and next-generation logistics hubs.

items.title: Green Tech of Beijing
items.description: Solar energy, hydrogen technology, and the research institutes shaping the climate agenda.
